b2plus-inca.title: As Soon As / When: -(y)IncA
b2plus-inca.explanation: -(y)IncA is a converb meaning 'as soon as / when,' more compact than -DIğI zaman and often implying the second action follows immediately: 'Eve varınca seni ararım' (As soon as I get home, I'll call you). Like -ArAk, it uses simple 2-way harmony and attaches to every verb with no exceptions, regardless of aorist irregularity.
b2plus-inca.fact: -(y)IncA describes a single triggering moment, not a repeated pattern -- for 'every time X happens,' Turkish instead reaches for -DIkçA, a related but distinct suffix.

dialogue.en: When will you let me know?
As soon as I decide, I'll tell you right away.

b2plus-dikca.title: As Long As / The More / Every Time: -DIkçA
b2plus-dikca.explanation: -DIkçA describes an action that continues alongside another, growing or repeating in step with it: 'Çalıştıkça gelişiyorum' (The more I work, the more I develop). It overlaps with ne kadar...o kadar but is more compact, a single clause instead of two parallel ones, and also covers 'every time X happens': 'Onu gördükçe gülümserim' (Every time I see him, I smile).
b2plus-dikca.fact: -DIkçA and -DIğIndA both build on the -DIk participle, but they mean different things: -DIğIndA marks a single moment ('when X happened'), while -DIkçA marks a repeated or ongoing correlation ('the more/every time X').

dialogue.en: How do you find this city?
The more I explore it, the more I love it.

b2plus-madikca.title: Unless / As Long As...Not: -mAdIkçA
b2plus-madikca.explanation: Negate -DIkçA and you get 'unless / as long as X doesn't happen': 'Çalışmadıkça başaramazsın' (Unless you work, you won't succeed). It's a strong, almost proverbial way to state a necessary condition, more forceful than a plain -mAzsA conditional.
b2plus-madikca.fact: -mAdIkçA pairs naturally with a negative result too, reinforcing the warning: 'Konuşmadıkça anlaşamayız' (Unless we talk, we can't understand each other) — both halves being negative is normal here, not a double-negative mistake.

dialogue.en: How will we solve this problem?
Unless we talk, we can't solve it.

items.en: As soon as I get home, I'll call you.
As soon as I heard the news, I got very happy.
As soon as I saw him, I couldn't recognize him.
As soon as you finish the job, let me know.

items.tr: Kapıyı açınca soğuk hava içeri girdi.
items.en: As soon as I opened the door, cold air came in.
As soon as she heard the music, she started dancing.
As soon as I learned the result, I started crying.
As soon as I recognized him, I was very surprised.
As soon as I wake up, the first thing I do is check my phone.
As soon as I get home, I wash my hands first.

items.tr: Kahvemi içince kendimi daha iyi hissederim.
items.en: As soon as I drink my coffee, I feel better.

items.tr: İşe başlayınca zaman nasıl geçiyor anlamıyorum.
items.en: As soon as I start work, I don't notice how time passes.
As soon as prices increased, nobody shopped.
As soon as it got dark, everyone went home.
As soon as the rain started, the match was stopped.
As soon as he started speaking, everyone fell silent.
As soon as I have money, I'll pay you back.
As soon as we're ready, let's leave.
As soon as the doctor arrived, the examination began.
As soon as I talked to him, everything became clear.

items.tr: O şarkıyı duyunca eski günleri hatırladım.
items.en: As soon as I heard that song, I remembered the old days.
As soon as I saw this photo, my eyes filled with tears.
As soon as I smelled that scent, I went back to my childhood.

items.tr: Onun sesini duyunca her şey aklıma geldi.
items.en: As soon as I heard his voice, everything came back to me.
As soon as the meeting ends, I'll prepare the report.
As soon as the approval comes, we can start the project.
As soon as the contract is signed, payment will be made.
As soon as the results are announced, we'll inform you.

items.tr: Onu kaybedince ne kadar değerli olduğunu anladım.
items.en: As soon as I lost him, I understood how valuable he was.
As soon as I learned the truth, I got very angry.
As soon as I made peace with him, I felt relieved.
As soon as I got this news, my world changed.

items.tr: Kapı çalınca kim geldi diye merak ettim.
items.en: As soon as the door rang, I wondered who had come.
As soon as the lights went out, everyone was surprised.
As soon as the speaker came on stage, applause began.
As soon as the bus departed, the journey had begun.
As soon as you get home, call me.
As soon as I heard the news, I came right away.
As soon as my work is finished, I'll rest.
As soon as I saw him, I understood everything.
The more I work, the more I develop.
The more I read, the more curious I get.
The more we talk, the better we understand each other.
The more I age, the more patient I become.
Every time I see him, I smile.

items.tr: Bu şarkıyı dinledikçe eski günleri hatırlıyorum.
items.en: Every time I listen to this song, I remember the old days.
Every time I look at this photo, I feel happy.

items.tr: Onunla konuştukça kendimi daha iyi hissediyorum.
items.en: Every time I talk to him, I feel better.

items.tr: Zaman geçtikçe onu daha çok özlüyorum.
items.en: As time passes, I miss him more.
As I get to know him, I trust him more.
As I keep trying, I believe in myself more.
As I grow up, I look at life differently.
The more I practice, the more fluently I speak.
As I gain experience, my job gets easier.

items.tr: Dinledikçe müziğe daha çok hayran kalıyorum.
items.en: The more I listen, the more amazed I am by the music.

items.tr: Seyahat ettikçe dünyayı daha iyi anlıyorum.
items.en: The more I travel, the better I understand the world.
As my money decreases, my worry increases.
As I age, my energy decreases.
The more I wait, the more my patience runs out.
As we grow apart, we understand each other less.
The more you share, the more it multiplies.
As you love, life becomes more meaningful.
The more you try, the closer you get to success.
The more you learn, the more humble you become.
As we get to know each other, the bond between us grows stronger.
The more we talk, the fewer our disagreements.

items.tr: Beraber vakit geçirdikçe daha yakın oluyoruz.
items.en: The more time we spend together, the closer we become.

items.tr: Zorluklarla karşılaştıkça birbirimize daha çok destek oluyoruz.
items.en: The more we face difficulties, the more we support each other.
As you go higher, the air gets colder.
As you go deeper, the pressure increases.
As the sun sets, the sky changes color.
As the population increases, cities grow.
Even though I get tired as I work, I don't give up.

items.tr: Zaman geçtikçe her şeyin daha kolay olacağını umuyorum.
items.en: As time passes, I hope everything will become easier.

items.tr: Öğrendikçe daha çok soru sormak istiyorum.
items.en: The more I learn, the more questions I want to ask.
As I get closer, my excitement increases.
The more I work, the more I develop.
Every time I see him, I get happy.

items.tr: Zaman geçtikçe her şey daha net oluyor.
items.en: As time passes, everything becomes clearer.
The more I try, the stronger I become.
Unless you work, you won't succeed.
Unless you try, you can't learn.
Unless we talk, we can't understand each other.
Unless you want it, nothing changes.
Unless you're careful, you'll make mistakes.
Unless you plan, you waste time.
Unless you ask, you can't get an answer.
Unless you take action, nothing happens.
Unless we save money, we can't buy that house.
Unless you practice, you can't speak fluently.
Unless you trust, you can't build a real relationship.
Unless you accept, there's no peace.
Unless you try, you can't win.
Unless you love, you can't understand.
Unless you fall, you can't learn to get up.
As long as you don't give up, you don't lose.

items.tr: Kendine güvenmedikçe başarılı olamazsın, bu yüzden özgüvenini geliştirmelisin.
items.en: Unless you trust yourself, you can't succeed, so you should build your self-confidence.

items.tr: Dinlemedikçe anlayamayız, o yüzden önce sussun herkes.
items.en: Unless we listen, we can't understand, so let everyone be quiet first.
Unless you work, you can't progress, don't forget this.
Unless you forgive, you can't find peace.
Unless we talk, problems don't get solved.
Unless we understand each other, we can't grow closer.
Unless there's trust, a relationship can't continue.
Unless we apologize, we can't make peace.
Unless you prepare, you can't pass the interview.
Unless the team works, this project won't finish.
Unless we share our ideas, we can't move forward.
Unless you take responsibility, you can't get promoted.
Unless we work together, big changes don't happen.

items.tr: Herkes katılmadıkça bu proje başarılı olamaz.
items.en: Unless everyone participates, this project can't succeed.
Unless you get an education, opportunities remain limited.
Unless people become aware, environmental problems don't get solved.

items.tr: Ne kadar zor olursa olsun, denemedikçe bilemeyiz.
items.en: No matter how hard it is, we can't know unless we try.
Even if we get tired, we shouldn't stop until we finish.

items.tr: Hazır olmasak bile, başlamadıkça hazır olamayız.
items.en: Even if we're not ready, we can't become ready unless we start.

items.tr: Zor gelse de, pes etmedikçe kaybetmiş sayılmayız.
items.en: Even if it feels hard, as long as we don't give up, we aren't considered to have lost.
Unless you try, you can't succeed.
Unless we talk, we can't understand each other.
Unless you work, nothing changes.
Unless you love, you can't truly understand.
